expectLegend.opens: Must open, report the page count, render page 1 and load text.
expectLegend.needs_password: Must ask for a password; opens with 'test123'; wrong password -> failure.
expectLegend.fails: Must fail gracefully with DocumentOpenException(failure) - never hang or crash.
expectLegend.fails_or_opens: Either opens (possibly with recovered pages) or fails with DocumentOpenException - never hangs or crashes.

files.description: One A4 page with two lines of Helvetica text.

20 A4 pages: headings, paragraphs, outline (19 chapters x 3 sections), internal links (TOC on page 1 + 'next chapter'), external https link, javascript: URI link, Launch action, OpenAction + Names JavaScript, one embedded file attachment.
3 image-only pages (JPEG 'scan', no text layer). Text extraction is empty; search must report 'no text layer' instead of failing.
tiny.pdf encrypted with AES-256 (R=6), user password 'test123'. Wrong password must give wrongPassword; cancel must give cancelled.
AES-256 with empty user password and an owner password; permissions deny print/copy/modify. Must open without a prompt; the app should show restrictions.
AcroForm with text (single + multiline), checkbox, radio group (3), combo box and list box fields.
One page of right-aligned Arabic and Hebrew text. Fonts: NotoSansArabic (SIL OFL 1.1, google/fonts); NotoSansHebrew (SIL OFL 1.1, google/fonts). Shaped with HarfBuzz: True.
One page of Hindi incl. conjuncts. Font: NotoSansDevanagari (SIL OFL 1.1, google/fonts). Shaped: True.
9 pages: /Rotate 0/90/180/270, A4/Letter/A5/landscape, 612x14400 long page, 14400x300 rotated banner, 200x200 square.
One page with an existing Highlight (with appearance stream), an Ink annotation and a Text (sticky note) annotation.
Empty file.
A PNG image with a .pdf extension.
A ZIP archive (containing a PDF) with a .pdf extension.
Plain text with a .pdf extension.
Valid header followed by 16 KiB of random bytes.
text_multi.pdf cut at 60% (no xref/trailer). PDFium may recover some pages.
First 64 bytes of tiny.pdf.
Classic xref table whose offsets all point to wrong places.
startxref points past EOF.
Trailer, startxref and %%EOF removed.
Trailer without /Root.
Pages tree whose /Kids reference the Pages node itself and each other.
Self-referencing Annots array, Parent loop, action /Next chain loop and an outline loop.
Outline whose items loop (/Next back to the first, /First to itself).
Page dictionary with an array nested 100,000 levels deep plus a 2000-level dict.
Content stream with 40,000 nested q/Q and 40,000 unclosed arrays.
/Count 1000000000 claimed, one real page. Must not allocate per claimed page.
/Count -5.
MediaBox [0 0 1e9 1e9]. Rendering must clamp the bitmap size (SecurityLimits.maxRenderPixels).
MediaBox with swapped corners.
Zero-area MediaBox.
Overflowing MediaBox numbers.
Page content stream: [/FlateDecode /FlateDecode] inflating to 1 GiB of whitespace.
Image XObject 20000x20000 RGB (1.2 GB decoded) from a tiny double-Flate stream.
Content stream marked FlateDecode containing random bytes.
Stream /Length far larger than the data.
TrueType with garbage FontFile2, Type0 with bogus /W and CIDToGIDMap, recursive Type3 font.
DCTDecode image: JPEG SOI/APP0 header then garbage.
JPXDecode image: JP2 signature box then garbage.
JBIG2Decode image with garbage data and garbage JBIG2Globals.
CCITTFaxDecode image with garbage.
Raw 640x480 RGB image with only 100 bytes.
Extra startxref section pointing to offset 0.
tiny.pdf plus 300 incremental-update sections whose /Prev chain loops.
Header claims PDF version 9.9.
Names with #00, invalid #ZZ hex escapes.
